note: Named Stack-Agent builds an experiment can select with agent.options.build. A build is a binary built from an exact rkendel1/stack-agent commit and installed at <AOC_STACK_AGENT_BUILDS_DIR or ~/.aoc-bins>/stack-agent-<commit>. The harness never builds or replaces one; it records the path, sha256, --version and commit of whatever it runs. Without agent.options.build the harness runs its default binary (AOC_STACK_AGENT_BIN, PATH, ...) and records that.
